scenario.topic: Decide which console the game café should feature this quarter

options.name: Nintendo Switch
options.upside: Offers a wide range of family-friendly and indie games with flexible play styles.
options.concern: Hardware may require frequent updates and accessories can add to costs.

options.name: PlayStation 5
options.upside: Strong lineup of exclusive games and powerful hardware for immersive experiences.
options.concern: Higher upfront cost and limited local multiplayer options.

options.name: Xbox Series X
options.upside: Access to a large game library through subscription and good multiplayer support.
options.concern: Less portable and may have fewer exclusive titles compared to competitors.

options.upside: Extensive game library and customizable hardware for varied gaming experiences.
options.concern: Higher initial investment and requires technical maintenance.

shared_context: The game café plans to feature one console this quarter to attract customers interested in multiplayer and single-player games. The decision involves three staff members considering factors like game library, hardware cost, and community support.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a mid-level manager passionate about immersive gaming experiences and exclusive titles.
personas.private_goal: To feature a console that showcases powerful hardware and top-tier exclusive games.

A.reason_for: Offers a wide range of family-friendly and indie games with flexible play styles.
A.reason_against: Hardware may require frequent updates and accessories can add to costs, and it lacks the power and exclusives I prefer.

B.reason_for: Strong lineup of exclusive games and powerful hardware for immersive experiences.

C.reason_for: Good multiplayer support and access to a large game library through subscription.
C.reason_against: Less exclusive content compared to PlayStation and less portable.

D.reason_for: Extensive game library and customizable hardware.
D.reason_against: Higher initial investment and requires technical maintenance, which may not suit the café environment.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is the café owner focused on cost-effectiveness and broad customer appeal.
personas.private_goal: To select the most affordable and family-friendly console to maximize customer turnout.

A.reason_for: Affordable hardware cost and a wide range of family-friendly and indie games with flexible play styles.

B.reason_against: Higher upfront cost and limited local multiplayer options make it unsuitable for broad café appeal.

C.reason_against: High hardware cost and less family-friendly exclusives reduce its suitability.

D.reason_against: Too expensive and requires technical maintenance, not practical for the café setting.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a community manager who values accessibility and multiplayer engagement.
personas.private_goal: To promote a console that encourages both local and online multiplayer participation.

A.reason_for: Supports both local and online multiplayer with a vast library of family-friendly and indie games.

B.reason_for: Strong exclusive games and powerful hardware.
B.reason_against: Limited local multiplayer options reduce its appeal for community gaming.

C.reason_for: Good multiplayer support and Xbox Game Pass offers access to many games.
C.reason_against: Less portable and fewer exclusives than competitors.

D.reason_against: High cost and maintenance needs make it less ideal for the café.
